coverage_assessment: Twenty-five open-web searches cover all four January weekly windows, both country names, two siSwati-term probes, four local news domains, labor/teachers, students, political-democracy, land/farm/economic terms, named regions, official and regional sources, and December 2020/February 2021 continuity. Eleven unique source cards (four opened, seven search-only) are retained. No January candidate is supported; the open web and limited local-language/archive coverage do not justify an absence or exhaustiveness claim.
